summary: Add the unwired iOS sidebar journal host with serialized persistence barriers and crash recovery.

replay.detail: No daemon replay changes; the unwired client host replays only pending immutable edit requests after durable persistence.

schema.detail: No database schema changes. The inactive local journal uses an explicit version-1 envelope.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: No production activation or wire changes. A future iOS v2 edit reducer supplies the durable state codec and reducer through the typed journal interface.

manual.detail: No manual steps; the module remains unwired.

recovery.detail: Rollback requires no migration because no production journal is created.
